news.headline: Wall Street slides: Nasdaq -1.5%, S&P 500 -0.5%
news.what_happened: US tech led a risk-off session; Nikkei also fell 3.5% while Hang Seng rose 1.1%.
news.why_it_matters: Global risk-off and a weak tech cue point to a soft open for Indian large caps and IT. Nifty was already -1.75% on its last session (Mon 23 Nov, close 25,349.65; NSE shut 24 Nov for Guru Nanak Jayanti).

news.headline: WTI crude -1.4% to ~$80.9, Brent ~$87.7
news.what_happened: Crude extended its decline, with WTI near its lowest levels since late summer.
news.why_it_matters: Lower crude cuts jet fuel and paint input costs; negative for upstream oil.

news.headline: Rupee flat at ~92.9; US 10Y yield ~4.90%
news.what_happened: USD/INR unchanged; dollar index flat near 103.8; gold steady near $3,564.
news.why_it_matters: No currency-driven edge for exporters. High US yields cap FII appetite for EMs.

sector_outlook.reason: Defensive in risk-off; cheaper packaging inputs

picks.logic: Jet fuel is ~35-40% of airline opex, so lower crude is a direct cost tailwind. Modest target given weak broader tape.
Crude derivatives are ~40-50% of paint raw-material cost; falling crude supports margins. Stock fell 1.1% last session, leaving room for a bounce.

picks.catalyst: Global risk-off (Nasdaq -1.5%, Nikkei -3.5%) plus lower crude
picks.logic: Defensive FMCG typically holds up when FIIs de-risk; cheaper crude-linked packaging inputs help margins.

risks: GIFT Nifty and FII/DII data were unavailable this morning; check the open before entering
